Technical SEO Audit Services

Ensure search engine crawlers can index and understand your website easily. Our technical SEO audits detect and resolve underlying issues in your site's code, speed, sitemaps, and structure to maximize organic reach.

Crawlability and Indexation Diagnostics

We analyze server log files, search console reports, and sitemaps to locate crawl errors, broken links, and redirect loops. We verify that all your main service pages are fully crawlable by search engine bots.

Site Speed and Core Web Vitals Optimization

Page load time directly affects user experience and search ranking. We audit LCP, INP, and CLS metrics. We optimize image sizes, reduce unused JS, and configure client caching to make your site load instantly.

Structured Schema Markup Audit

We check and implement structured data schemas (LocalBusiness, Organization, Service, WebSite) to help search engines display your content as rich results (like rating stars or FAQs) in search listings.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is a Technical SEO audit?

A technical SEO audit is a review of your website's non-content elements, such as page speed, coding bugs, mobile display issues, sitemaps, and index status.

How often should I run a technical audit?

We recommend running a detailed technical audit at least twice a year to ensure new code updates have not caused indexing or speed issues.
